# Roundy

Roundy runs in-person community events and guided Korean and English language exchange in Seoul.

- [Program and upcoming sessions](https://roundy.team/)
- [About Roundy](https://roundy.team/about)
- [How it works](https://roundy.team/how-it-works)
- [Refund policy](https://roundy.team/refund-policy)

Use current event pages for availability and pricing. Member profiles, messages, tickets and admin tools are private.
